name: punc
description: What does a book look like without words? Count and draw the punctuation in any text file.

scripts.build: tsc --emitDeclarationOnly && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --external:pdfkit --external:through2 --external:@resvg/resvg-js && esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/cli.js --external:pdfkit --external:through2 --external:@resvg/resvg-js --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node'
scripts.check: npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run markdown-lint && npm test
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.site:serve: npm run site:build && python3 -m http.server 4173 -d site-dist
scripts.test:visual: docker run --rm --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/work -v /work/node_modules -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.65.0-noble bash -c 'npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npx playwright test --project=visual-desktop --project=visual-phone'
scripts.test:visual:update: docker run --rm --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/work -v /work/node_modules -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.65.0-noble bash -c 'npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npx playwright test --project=visual-desktop --project=visual-phone --update-snapshots'
